followup.card.body: An assessment a few weeks from now shows how things have changed. Choose when this app should offer a new one; nothing is sent anywhere.
followup.card.title: Look again later
followup.ics.body: A calendar file with one all-day entry on {date}. It says only that it is time to look again and holds no health information. Once it is in a calendar it stays there and may be copied by the services that calendar uses. Nothing can be sent from this app, so the file is a note to yourself.
followup.ics.summary: TCM Self-Check — time to look again
followup.ics.title: Add to my calendar
followup.nudge.profile.hint: Only the answers about the person are carried over: age, sex, pregnancy, medicines, allergies and conditions, and birth data if it was saved. The symptoms are asked again.
followup.nudge.text: It has been about {n} weeks since the last assessment. Would you like to look again?
followup.nudge.title: Time to look again?
followup.set: A card will appear on the start page and in History from {date}.
